URL: https://docs.crustdata.com/api-reference/web-apis/web-search
Title: Web Search (Live)

Description: Perform a web search query and return results from multiple sources including web, news, academic articles, academic author profiles, deep research results, and social media. Use for competitive intelligence, market research, lead generation, and content discovery.

Rate limit: Default 15 requests per minute.

Method: POST
URL: https://api.crustdata.com/web/search/live

Auth: Bearer token (required)
Headers: x-api-version (enum, required; must equal "2025-11-01")

Body (application/json):
  query: string (required, 1..5000) — supports site:, filetype:
  location: string | null — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (US, CA, MX, BR, AR, CL, CO, PE, VE, GB, DE,
    FR, IT, ES, PT, NL, BE, CH, AT, PL, SE, NO, DK, FI, IE, RU, UA, CZ, GR, TR, RO, HU, JP, CN, KR, IN,
    ID, TH, VN, MY, SG, PH, TW, HK, SA, AE, IL, EG, AU, NZ, ZA, NG, KE)
  sources: array of enum | null — news, web, scholar-articles, scholar-articles-enriched, scholar-author,
    ai, social
  site: string | null — restrict to a site domain (e.g., "linkedin.com/company", "site:github.com"),
    max 500 chars
  start_date: integer | null — Unix seconds
  end_date: integer | null — Unix seconds
  human_mode: boolean (default false) — attempt Cloudflare bypass
  page: integer (default 1, min 1) — number of result pages

Response (200):
  success: boolean (required)
  query: string (required, echoed)
  timestamp: integer (required, Unix ms)
  results: array (required) —
    - source: string ("web"|"news"|"scholar-articles"|"scholar-author"|"ai"|"social"|...)
    - title: string (for ai: overview title)
    - url: string
    - snippet: string (web/news/scholar-articles)
    - position: integer >=1 (web/news/scholar-articles)
    - metadata: string | null (scholar-articles citation string)
    - pdf_url: string | null (scholar-articles)
    - authors: array | null (scholar-articles)
    - citations: integer | { all, since_2020 } (scholar-articles | scholar-author)
    - name, affiliation, website, interests, thumbnail, h_index, i10_index, articles — scholar-author
    - content: string | null — ai overview content
    - references: array | null — ai
    - images: array | null — ai
  metadata: { totalResults, failedPages, emptyPages } (required)
